(Japanese: '''偽ライジングボルテッカーズ登場！？''' ''Enter the Fake {{tt|Rising Volteccers|Rising Volt Tacklers}}!?'') is the 138th episode of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', and the 1,370th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It is scheduled to air in Japan on May 29, 2026<!-- and is scheduled to air in the United States on *day*-->.
